training.holdout_policy: No event from 2024 or later is allowed in training.
training.feature_policy: city and district identity excluded from predictors

validation_gate.policy: Every target must achieve ROC-AUC >= 0.65 and positive MSE skill in every configured grouped evaluation.

cross_validation.strategy: grouped by complete year; no random row split and no city/district identity predictor
cross_validation.baseline_strategy: Each validation event receives only its training fold's target prevalence.

validation_gate.policy: Every target must have year-grouped ROC-AUC >= 0.65 and lower MSE than a fold-specific prevalence baseline.
